title: Which activist detained in Tunisia's Global Sumud Flotilla fundraising case will suspend his hunger strike between September 12 and September 27, 2026?
background: Four activists have been detained since March in a Tunisian investigation into alleged financial irregularities involving fundraising for the Global Sumud Flotilla, an international campaign seeking to deliver aid to Gaza. Hunger strikes are being used to protest their continued detention.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera identifying which of the four detained activists has suspended his hunger strike. 
  Resolution Conditions : The suspension must have occurred between September 12 and September 27, 2026, inclusive. Appeals to suspend the strike or statements of future intention do not count. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The activist's full name.
